_doc: Frozen power standard for DAX W1. See dax/memo/PI_DECISION_D3_2026-08-18.md. This file is the ONLY source of the pass bar. Nothing may recompute it from the analysis sample; freeze_power_standard.py fills it once from the frozen pre-event CPS extract and refuses to overwrite without --force.

frozen_window.rationale: Ends the month before the first eligible event (GPT4_LAUNCH, 2023-03), so the constant cannot contain any post-treatment information.

benchmark.quantity: relative decline in EMPLOYMENT (headcount), not payroll
benchmark.measured_in: ADP administrative payroll data — 'payroll' names the DATA SOURCE, not the outcome variable. This distinction is what M2 flagged.
benchmark.population: workers ages 22-25 in the most AI-exposed occupations
benchmark.citation: Brynjolfsson, E., B. Chandar, and R. Chen. 2025. "Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of Artificial Intelligence." Working paper.
locators: docs/DAX_ERE_Proposal_v3.md:12 (the claim, in the project's own proposal)
benchmark.version_note: Figure moved across revisions of the same paper: 0.13 (version cited by DAX_ERE_Proposal_v3), reportedly 0.16 (later revision), 0.19 (August 2026, ADP through June 2026). PI chose 0.19 on 2026-08-18. This loosens the pass bar by ~46% relative to 0.13; the choice was made before any outcome data existed and before the frozen baseline was computed, so it cannot have been informed by a result.
benchmark.locator_caveat: 0.19 is PI-directed. It is NOT yet sourced to a locator: every host carrying the paper (digitaleconomy.stanford.edu, thedocs.worldbank.org, bharatchandar.substack.com) is egress-blocked from the build environment, so no version was read and the figure rests on web-search summaries. The PI accepted this after the gap was stated. Upgrade locator_status to VERIFIED and record page/section once the Canaries_August2026.pdf excerpt is supplied. Until then any writeup citing this constant must say the figure is taken from the August 2026 revision without a page cite.

forbidden: recomputing after the event set, mapping, dose definition, window rule or sample changes
reporting adequately_powered while status is not FROZEN
treating failure as licence to search over specifications
